meta.en_title: DISCLOSEABLE AND CONNECTED TRANSACTION — ACQUISITION OF 60% EQUITY INTEREST IN HARBOUR LOGISTICS LIMITED
meta.zh_title: 須予披露及關連交易 — 收購海港物流有限公司60%股權

en.text: The Consideration is HK$12.4 million, payable in cash on Completion.

zh.text: 代價為港幣1,210萬元，於完成時以現金支付。

findings.explanation: English states HK$12.4 million; Chinese states HK$12.1 million.

en.text: If the Conditions are not fulfilled on or before 31 December 2026 (the "Long Stop Date"), the Agreement shall lapse.

zh.text: 倘條件未能於二零二六年十一月三十日（「最後截止日期」）或之前達成，本協議將告失效。

findings.explanation: English long stop date is 31 December 2026; Chinese is 30 November 2026.

en.text: (c) the Independent Shareholders having approved the Acquisition at the EGM.

zh.text: (b) 賣方已就收購事項取得所有必要的第三方同意；

findings.explanation: Condition (c), Independent Shareholders' approval at the EGM, is absent from the Chinese version.

findings.section: REASONS FOR AND BENEFITS OF THE ACQUISITION

en.text: Following Completion, the Group may consider further acquisitions in the logistics sector.

zh.text: 完成後，本集團將考慮於物流行業進行進一步收購。

findings.explanation: English is conditional (may consider); Chinese is definite (將考慮, will consider).

en.text: The Company shall procure the payment of the Consideration from its internal resources.

zh.text: 本集團須以內部資源促使支付代價。

findings.explanation: The obligation sits with the Company in English but with the Group (本集團) in Chinese.

en.text: The Target is principally engaged in the provision of freight forwarding and warehousing services in Hong Kong.

zh.text: 目標公司主要於香港從事貨運代理及倉儲服務。

findings.explanation: Equivalent in meaning; the Chinese drops "the provision of", which carries no content.

en.text: For the year ended 31 December 2025, the Target recorded revenue of approximately HK$48,200,000.

zh.text: 截至二零二五年十二月三十一日止年度，目標公司錄得收益約港幣4,820萬元。

findings.explanation: Same value, different notation: HK$48,200,000 vs 港幣4,820萬元.

en.text: Shareholders and potential investors should exercise caution when dealing in the Shares.

zh.text: 股東及潛在投資者於買賣股份時務請審慎行事。

findings.explanation: Boilerplate cross-reference to the circular timetable appears only in English.
